known.title: Research says that grep matches --exclude-dir against the folder path under the search root, but GNU grep matches the base name of each subfolder, so A2 also prints the frozen plans and cannot pass
known.locator: Research, GNU grep bullet (line 17); Acceptance, row A2 (line 39)
known.summary: The bullet says that GNU grep matches `--exclude-dir` against the folder path under the search root, so `--exclude-dir=docs/plans/finished` skips only the frozen plans, and A2 uses that option with the expectation of zero live hits. The GNU grep manual (https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/manual/grep.html, --exclude-dir=glob) says that a recursive search skips 'any subdirectory whose base name matches glob'; a base name holds no slash, so the glob `docs/plans/finished` matches no subfolder (checked with GNU grep 3.12: the files under docs/plans/finished/ are still printed). At repo_ref, docs/plans/finished/ holds effect-kit mentions (for example 2026-07-03-effect-kit-migration.md), which the plan keeps (Do not touch). So A2 prints hits after a correct removal and fails.

known.title: Research says that ci-plugin-targeting.mjs builds its cases from the registry and names no plugin, but at repo_ref it asserts effect-kit literally in many places, and step 3 leaves it out, so the full gate fails
known.locator: Research, ci-plugin-targeting bullet (line 14); Steps, row 3 contracts, Files (line 30); Acceptance, row A1 (line 38)
known.summary: The bullet says that scripts/tests/ci-plugin-targeting.mjs names no plugin literally and needs no edit, and step 3 does not list it. At repo_ref the file names effect-kit about 40 times: for example line 1609 asserts that the registry targets equal ['docks', 'effect-kit', 'plan-lifecycle'], line 1611 expects the error text 'docks, effect-kit, plan-lifecycle', line 1819 expects the trees ['plugins/docks', 'plugins/effect-kit', 'plugins/plan-lifecycle'], and lines 494-560 run a targeted gate with `--plugin effect-kit`. scripts/ci.mjs (line 307) runs this file with `--unit` in the full gate. So after steps 1 and 2 the gate of step 5 and A1 fail, and A2 finds the literals. Step 3 must update this file.

known.title: No step changes plugins/plan-lifecycle/test/selftest.mjs, which reads the effect-kit manifests and skill files that step 1 deletes, so the self-test of A4 and the gate fail
known.locator: Research, dependent-contracts bullet (line 13); Steps, row 3 contracts, Files (line 30); Acceptance, row A4 (line 41)
known.summary: Step 1 deletes plugins/effect-kit/. At repo_ref, plugins/plan-lifecycle/test/selftest.mjs reads plugins/effect-kit/skills/engineering/effect-ts-port/SKILL.md and effect-ts-setup/SKILL.md (lines 54-55, through LIFECYCLE_ROUTE_FILES and read() at line 14), reads both effect-kit manifests with readJson (lines 102-103), and asserts the effect-kit catalog version and dependency (lines 104-115) and names it in its pass line (line 131). The dependent-contracts bullet and the Files of step 3 do not name this file. So after step 1 the self-test throws on a missing file, A4 fails, and the plan-lifecycle plugin gate (scripts/ci.mjs lines 490-493 run the self-test) fails. Step 3 must remove these reads and assertions.
